_comment: The closed classes of a failed Ollama model pull, first match wins, matched as a plain substring, without case, of Ollama's error message (the CLI's last `Error:` line on Windows, the `error` field of an /api/pull frame on macOS and Linux). The transport classes come before `manifest`: Ollama prefixes a failed fetch with `pull model manifest`. A `digest_mismatch` pull is pulled once more: Ollama deletes the layer whose sha256 did not match before it reports the mismatch, so the next pull downloads it afresh. Linux reads this file; the Windows copy (windows/ai/engine/ollama/managed_bootstrap.ahk LLM_OLLAMA_PULL_ERROR_CLASSES) and the macOS copy (macos/ai/engine/ollama/managed_ollama_pull.py ERROR_CLASSES) are pinned to it by tests/unit/ai/servers/test_ollama_managed_bootstrap.ahk.
